question: The ‘Pattachitra’ style of painting is a popular art form associated with the state of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pattachitra Art is the folk painting of Odisha.**
 
• It contains scenes **related to the life of Lord Krishna.**
 
• The name Pattachitra has evolved from the Sanskrit word** Patta, meaning canvas**, and **Chitra, meaning picture.**
 
• Pattachitra is thus a painting done on canvas and is thus a** painting done on colorful application, creative motifs and designs, and portrayal of simple themes, mostly mythological in depiction.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Some of the popular themes represented through this art form are
 
 
• **Thia Badhia**- depiction of the temple of Jagannath;
 
• **Krishna Lila**- enactment of Jagannath as Lord Krishna displaying his powers as a child'
 
• **Dasabatara Patti-** the ten incarnations of Lord Vishnu; Panchamukhi- depiction of Lord Ganesh as a five-headed deity.
